question: 'Imperfect' is an autobiography of ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Manjrekar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book '**Imperfect**' is the autobiography of batsman turned commentator Sanjay Manjerakor.
 
• The book talks about his cricket career, his life and his obsession with batting technique, the quest for perfection.
 
• Sanjay Manjrekar played **37 **Tests and **74 **ODI matches for Indian Team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc13157d7496099e91d2f8d3850c18d351a0b97ad46b1fddcc80711a353cea33.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rahul Dravid's biography was written by Devendra Prabhudesai in the book "**The Nice Guy Who Finished Firs**t".
 
• Ravi Shastri's autobiography was written in "**Stargazing: The players in My Life**"
 
• Milkha Singh and his daughter, Sonia Sanwalka, co-wrote his autobiography, titled **The Race of My Life**.
